dropped.name: Leonard Golf Links (3200 Chapel Creek Blvd, Fort Worth)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — no rated/playable course. Verified: it is a 52-acre practice and instruction facility only (62 lighted Tiff Bermuda tee stations, 12 target greens with bunkers, a 10,000 sq ft putting green, two 8,000 sq ft chipping/putting greens, pro shop, PGA instruction under Michael Martin). Official practice home of the TCU golf teams. GolfPass files it under DRIVING RANGES, not courses. The BlueGolf/SkyGolf 'scorecard' entry that prompted the sweep to include it carries impossible data ('par 72 / 1,800 yards') and appears to be a database artifact. Falls under the brief's driving-range exclusion.

dropped.name: The Club at Los Rios / Los Rios Country Club (1700 Country Club Dr, Plano)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — PERMANENTLY CLOSED. Don January / Billy Martindale design (early 1970s), par 71, ~6,457 yds. Golf operations ended around 2019-2020; the City of Plano bought the ~194-acre property for ~$3.5M and it is now Los Rios Park, an open-space preserve. GolfPass, GolfNow, Supreme Golf and Chronogolf ALL still carry live-looking listings — this is the single biggest stale-data trap in Collin County. Do not re-add.

dropped.reason: DROPPED — PERMANENTLY CLOSED. Public 9-hole course (par 34, ~2,119 yds) that opened 1999 and closed circa 2008; Yelp marks it closed. Still carried as active by GolfPass, GolfLink, AllSquare and other aggregators — stale data.

dropped.name: Pecan Trails Golf Course (4978 Edgefield Ln, Midlothian)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — PERMANENTLY CLOSED (verified this pass; the sweep had it as 'uncertain'). The course's own site states it closed on an indefinite basis during the pandemic and never reopened, and the Yelp listing carries a CLOSED banner updated May 2026. Tee times still appear on Chronogolf/GolfNow/TeeTimeAgent/Stymie and PGA.com still lists it — all stale. This means the city of Midlothian now has NO operating golf course.

Listings explicitly state 'this location is closed for business', with user reviews noting closure going back to 2015. No website, no active tee-time channel. Still listed by GolfPass, GolfLink, HAR, SkyGolf and texasgolf.com.

Yelp carries a CLOSED banner updated January 2026. GolfPass, PGA.com, GolfNow and TeeOff all still list it as active — stale. dropped.name: Fun City Golf Course / Fun City Golf Center (3990 Westcliff Rd, Grand Prairie)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — CLOSED. 9-hole par-27 course, 1,098 yds, built 1995 by Henry & Kathy Krabbenschmidt, attached to a family-entertainment/range operation. Yelp carries a CLOSED banner updated February 2026. GolfNow, TeeOff, Chronogolf, HAR and golfstayandplays still list it. Yelp's closed-banner signal proved accurate for every other DFW course tested this pass (Three Oaks, Hank Haney Vista Ridge, North Mesquite, Pecan Trails), so it is dropped rather than kept as uncertain — but a phone call to 972-262-0022 would settle it definitively.

dropped.name: I Care Fitness Center & Golf Course (242 Idlewild St, Grand Prairie)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — not verifiable as a real rated course. Appears only in scraped aggregator directories (TheGolfNexus, SkyGolf browse pages, hotel-guide scrapers) as a '9-hole semi-private' entry with a phone number. No official site, no tee-time listing, no reviews, no scorecard, no recent references of any kind. Almost certainly defunct or never a rated course.

dropped.name: Gentle Creek Country Club / Gentle Creek Golf Club (3131 E Prosper Trl, Prosper)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — now PRIVATE, member-only. D.A. Weibring design (2002), operated by Arcis Golf. Verified this pass: the club's own site and Arcis both present it as a private club ('Gentle Creek is a private golf club in Prosper, TX'), GolfPass lists it Private, and GolfNow shows no bookable public tee times. The public access older guides describe was a temporary arrangement while memberships filled. Full golf initiation reportedly $50k-$75k.

dropped.name: Heath Golf & Yacht Club (1500 Clubhouse Dr, Heath)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — PRIVATE. Roy Bechtol design, 18 holes (~7,068 yds, par 72) inside a master-planned residential/resort community; GolfPass splits it into a '1st Nine' and '2nd Nine'. Verified this pass: the club's own materials state the course is private and available to members and their guests only, and GolfPass tags the 2nd Nine 'Resort/Private'. GolfLink and a few directories list it public — those are wrong. If OpenTee later confirms an outside-play channel by phone at (972) 552-6079, re-add as two nines.

dropped.name: Cedar Creek Country Club (Kemp, Cedar Creek Lake)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — PRIVATE. Verified this pass: GolfPass, PGA.com, HAR and the club's own membership messaging all describe it as a private club on the shores of Cedar Creek Lake, with memberships from ~$85/month. The public-facing 'Book a Tee Time' page and wedding/event marketing that made the sweep flag it are member-booking and event-venue channels, not general daily-fee access. GolfNow carries a facility page (13822) and GolfMoose sells discounted rounds, so a phone call to (903) 498-6761 could still reverse this.

dropped.name: The Oaks Country Club (271 W Jack Finney Blvd, Greenville)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — member/private, no confirmable public tee times. Founded 1960, 9 holes played twice for par 72, ~6,500 yds, with ballroom, restaurant and pool. Verified this pass: the club's own site (theoaks.golf) is entirely membership- and event-oriented with no published guest green fee or public booking channel, and GolfLink's Greenville summary counts the city as one municipal course (Wright Park) plus one private course. PGA/GolfLink tag it 'semi-private', which is why it is listed here rather than silently omitted — re-add as semi_private if (903) 455-3971 confirms outside play.

dropped.name: The Dance Floor putting course (PGA Frisco, Frisco)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — not a teed golf course. A ~75,000 sq ft natural-grass putting course with no fixed hole count, no tees and no rating. GolfPass and PGA Frisco list it as a separate 'course' for marketing purposes, which is why the sweep captured it (with hole_count 0). Excluded as a practice/putting green under the same rule that excludes driving ranges. The Swing, the 10-hole lighted par-3 at the same property, IS retained.

dropped.name: Stonebriar Country Club — Country Club Course (Frisco)
dropped.reason: DROPPED — strictly private, member-only. The second 18 at Stonebriar; unlike the Fazio Course it has no resort-guest access channel. The Fazio Course is retained as 'resort' with an access caveat.

courses.notes: Formerly 'Split Rail Links & Golf Club'. Phil Lumsden links-style design built 2002, up to 7,353 yds, par 72. Now Troon-managed; sells memberships but takes daily-fee public tee times up to 14 days out through its own booking engine. East Parker County, ~30 min west of Fort Worth.

courses.facility_name: The Golf Club at Twin Creeks
courses.notes: Arnold Palmer Signature design operated by Arcis Golf. Marketed as daily-fee with country-club amenities and sells public tee times (GolfNow facility #1416); some directories classify it semi-private. The only golf course inside Allen city limits.

Owned by the City of Azle. Jeff Brauer design opened 1995. Par 72, 6,734 yds back / 5,051 forward, Champion Bermuda greens. Azle spans the Tarrant/Parker line; the course is on the Tarrant side. (817) 444-4940.

courses.facility_name: Benbrook Lake Golf (Benbrook Lighted Par 3 & Range)
courses.notes: CORE-METRO GAP — a genuine playable 9-hole course in Tarrant County that the master list missed entirely (the list has Whitestone in Benbrook but not this). 9 holes, par 27, ~929 yds; holes range 62-177 yds. Fully LIGHTED for night play — official site advertises 9-hole and 18-hole (two-loop) rates: $12/$22 weekdays, $15/$25 weekends. Frank Reynolds design opened 1993; Debbie Reynolds is co-owner. No tee time required ('we can get you and your group right onto the course'). Weekly Wednesday-night scramble. Same property also has a 100-stall lighted driving range across two locations, an 18-hole lighted MINI-GOLF course (not a rated course — do not double-count), batting cages and an events center; count only the par-3 as a course. Hours: Nov 3-Mar 9 9am-8pm (last tee 6:30pm); Mar 10-Nov 2 8am-10pm (last tee 8:30pm). Phone (817) 249-4653. Confirmed operating: GolfPass Benbrook city directory lists it 'Public' with 32 reviews, Yelp page updated July 2026 with no closed banner, Benbrook Chamber member listing active. HOLE-COUNT CAUTION: the facility's own prices page says '18-hole lighted par 3 course', but GolfLink, GolfDigest, par3nearme, 9holegolfcourses and the Chamber all say 9 holes — the 18 figure is two loops of the nine. Aliases in databases: 'Benbrook 3 Par', 'Benbrook Par Three Golf', 'Benbrook Lighted Par 3 & Range'.

courses.address: 10650 US Highway 377 S (Benbrook Blvd), Benbrook, TX 76126
courses.notes: WEBSITE RESOLVED (the sweep left it blank): whitestonegolf.com confirmed as the official domain. Open to the public, managed by Elite Golf. Jeff Brauer / Jay Morrish design opened May 2000. Par 72, 7,117 yds, rating 74.0. Booking 2026 tee times via GolfNow/Chronogolf/RapidTee. (817) 249-9996. Address also cited as 10650 Benbrook Blvd — same road.

courses.address: 555 E Hidden Creek Pkwy, Burleson, TX 76028
courses.notes: Owned and operated by the City of Burleson (staff appear in the burlesontx.com directory). Par 72, 7,024 yds. (817) 447-4444. Burleson straddles the Tarrant/Johnson line; this site is on the Johnson County side.

Built 1999, par 72, 7,311 yds. Closed abruptly one November, then reopened Feb 1 under new ownership (Shipman Companies / the Niles family) with Elite Golf managing; clubhouse bar and lighted range renovated. Open to public play; 2026 reviews confirm operating. (817) 426-2400.

MSA GAP — Hunt County is a DFW MSA county and the master list carried only Wright Park (Greenville) and Deer Run (West Tawakoni). GolfPass classifies it Semi-Private and multiple directories state it is open to the public. 9 regulation holes, par 36, 3,045 yds white / 2,459 red; two sets of tees allow an 18-hole double loop (this is the source of '18 hole' entries in some directories). Built 1962. Zoysia turf, water and trees in play, no bunkers. ACCESS CAVEAT: on Saturdays and Sundays the course is reserved for MEMBERS ONLY between 11am and 3pm — outside play is fine at other times. CONFIRMED CURRENT: most recent GolfPass review dated April 25, 2026; active Facebook page. (903) 886-4455. Campbell is ~7.5 miles east of Greenville.

Daily-fee public course that also sells memberships (effectively semi-private), so some directories label it semi-private. Confirmed open and taking public tee times in 2026. (972) 395-0786. In the Denton County part of Carrollton next to The Colony / Lewisville line.

36-hole City of Carrollton muni — two separate 18s (Creek and Lakes) built by Dick Phelps in the Indian Creek / Elm Fork Trinity floodplain; water in play on 34 of the 36 holes. The facility is in the Denton County portion of Carrollton. (972) 466-9850.
Second 18 at the City of Carrollton's Indian Creek complex. Fully renovated in 2019 (new greens, fairways, cart paths); popular walking course.

ACCESS VERIFIED — KEPT AS PUBLIC (sweep had flagged it uncertain). 9-hole par-3, par 27, ~1,221 yds, opened 1975, inside The Country Place gated residential community north of Dallas. GolfPass confirms it is open to the public with visitors welcome every day, and the pro shop takes tee times at (972) 416-0660. Residual caveat: it is primarily an HOA/neighborhood amenity behind a gate, so a phone call is still worth making before advertising unrestricted access. Reclassified from semi_private to daily_fee.

City of Cleburne-owned. John Colligan links-style layout on Lake Pat Cleburne, opened July 4 2009 on the site of the former Lake Pat Cleburne Municipal Golf Course (closed 2007 for the rebuild) — treat any surviving 'Lake Pat Cleburne Municipal' record as the same site, not a second course. 7,068 yds from the tips. Pro shop (817) 641-4501; open daily 7am to 30 min before sunset.

courses.address: 920 E Katherine P Rains Rd, Cleburne, TX 76031
courses.notes: STATUS RESOLVED — KEPT AS OPEN. The sweep flagged a conflict (Golf Digest listing marked closed, newest GolfPass review 2016). Verified: the Yelp listing was updated February 2026 WITHOUT a 'CLOSED' banner (Yelp does explicitly banner closed golf courses — it does so for Three Oaks, Hank Haney Vista Ridge and Fun City), and TeeOff/GolfNow/PGA all carry it live. 9-hole par-3 (par 27, ~1,073 yds) plus lighted driving range, chipping/putting areas and teaching pro. (817) 774-1999. Official site returns 403 to automated fetching. A phone call would still be the gold standard.
The only golf course located in Coppell. Daily-fee public, ~6,593 yds, Champion bermuda greens, water on 14 of 18 holes; ~10 minutes from DFW Airport. Confirmed operating 2026.

RENAME: this is the former Creekview Golf Club — bought July 2017, renovated (new Champion bermuda greens, rebuilt bunkers, expanded clubhouse) and reopened August 2018 as Rusted Rail. Many directories still carry a stale 'Creekview Golf Club, Hwy 175, Crandall' record; same facility, not a second course. Single 18, Dick Phelps design (1995), par 72, up to ~7,218-7,249 yds. Tee times at rustedrail.teesnap.net.

courses.address: 3500 Bear Creek Ct, DFW Airport, TX 75261
courses.notes: 36-hole daily-fee facility on the southwest corner of DFW International Airport property, operated by Arcis Golf; formerly the Hyatt Bear Creek complex. Two Ted Robinson 18s (East and West). East is par 72, ~6,670 yds (73.4/138). Confirmed operating 2026. CITY/COUNTY CAVEAT: the 75261 airport ZIP causes it to be listed variously as Dallas, Euless, Grapevine or Irving; the property's SW-corner location puts it in Tarrant County, but a parcel check is warranted since the airport straddles Dallas and Tarrant. Mailing: PO Box 613108, Dallas, TX 75261.

courses.address: 3500 Bear Creek Ct, DFW Airport, TX 75261
courses.notes: Second of the two Ted Robinson 18s at Bear Creek Golf Club, par 72, ~6,690 yds. Same clubhouse and tee sheet as the East Course. Recognized by Golf Digest among the Top 50 Resort Courses in America.

City of Dallas Park & Recreation muni. A.W. Tillinghast design opened 1919 as a country club; host of the 1927 PGA Championship. Oak Cliff / South Dallas. Pro shop (214) 670-7615. Confirmed operating.

courses.address: 2323 N Jim Miller Rd, Dallas, TX 75227
courses.notes: City of Dallas muni in Pleasant Grove/East Dallas. Opened 1979, Dave Bennett design, ~6,521 yds, par 72. Marketed as both 'Grover C. Keeton' and 'Keeton Park' — one facility. Driving range and snack bar. (214) 670-8784.

MERGED (found by dallas-city and denton-nw-suburbs sweeps). City of Dallas muni inside the L.B. Houston Sports Complex, NW Dallas. Formerly L.B. Houston Golf Course (1969), renamed Luna Vista after a 2012 renovation — stale databases may carry 'L.B. Houston' as a separate record; it is the same course. Par 72, ~6,800 yds. Nearest public course to Farmers Branch/Addison. (214) 670-6322.
City of Dallas muni in Oak Cliff (Kessler Park). Opened 1922-24 as Dallas' second muni; fully redesigned and reopened 2011 by Colligan Golf Design. Hilly with downtown skyline views.

One of TWO distinct 18s at the 36-hole City of Dallas Tenison Park facility (East Dallas, near Samuell Grand Park / White Rock Lake). Tenison Glen is the older tree-lined layout and was Dallas' first municipally owned course (1924). Do not merge with Tenison Highlands — many directories wrongly list 'Tenison Park' as a single 18. Facility (214) 670-1402.

Second 18 at the 36-hole Tenison Park muni. Championship layout ~7,078 yds, D.A. Weibring redesign. Shares clubhouse and tee sheet with Tenison Glen. 'The Range at Tenison Park' at the same address is range-only and is not a course.

courses.address: 2200 W Red Bird Ln, Dallas, TX 75232
courses.notes: The only non-municipal course inside Dallas city limits selling public tee times. Perry Maxwell design, opened 1953 as Oak Cliff Country Club; host of the PGA Tour Dallas Open 1958-62 and 1964-67. Sells memberships but publishes public green fees and books on GolfNow (facility 7818). ~6,719 yds. Southern Dallas (Red Bird).

Semi-private golf and tennis club (managed by Encore Leisure Group) that does sell public tee times via GolfNow/GolfLink — included as public-access. Built 1983. Several older directories incorrectly label it strictly 'Private'. 972-296-2146.

courses.facility_name: Decatur Golf Club (formerly Decatur Country Club)
courses.notes: ADDED BY CONSOLIDATION (Wise County gap). 9 holes, par 36, 3,233 yds, opened 1952. Open year-round to the public. Listed in older directories as 'Decatur Country Club' — same facility, renamed Decatur Golf Club. ACCESS/OWNERSHIP NOTE: rates are published on the City of Decatur parks site (decatur-parks.org/decatur-golf/), which indicates city involvement in operations; some sources describe it as privately owned but open to the public. Recorded municipal — verify ownership. (940) 627-3789.

9-hole regulation public course, par 35, opened 2003, bermuda greens, rolling terrain. Confirmed open in 2026 with a published event schedule; hours 7am-6pm daily. Some sources spell it 'Timber Links'. NOTE: the City of Denton owns NO municipal golf course — its North Lakes facility is a driving range only.

courses.facility_name: Wildhorse Golf Club at Robson Ranch
courses.notes: 27-hole semi-private facility inside the Robson Ranch active-adult community but explicitly open to the public (non-residents can book; military/first-responder rates). All 27 holes by Gary Stephenson. Three named nines — North, South, West — played in three rotating 18-hole combinations daily except Mondays (GolfPass lists them as North/South, South/West, West/North; modeling as three nines avoids triple-counting). North is the newest, opened 2019. (940) 246-1012.

courses.facility_name: Wildhorse Golf Club at Robson Ranch
courses.notes: One of the two original nines (opened 2001 as part of the first 18). Combined with West or North for daily 18-hole rotations.

courses.facility_name: Wildhorse Golf Club at Robson Ranch
courses.notes: The other original 2001 nine. Combined with South or North for daily 18-hole rotations.

18-hole public daily-fee course, Bill Schober design opened 1987; walking permitted, bermuda greens and fairways. ALIAS: older directories list this same address as 'Summit Golf Club' — same facility, renamed. Bookable via TeeItUp/Chronogolf/Stymie, confirming active operation. 972-878-4653.

Semi-private club that welcomes daily-fee/public play and lists tee times on GolfNow and TeeOff. Open year round, first tee time 7:00am, soft spikes required. 972-875-3642. No official website found. Distinct facility from Lakeside Country Club despite both sitting on Country Club Rd in Ennis.

Historic 9-hole semi-private course founded 1925, confirmed semi-private and open. Green fee about $22.50 any day, hours ~8:00am-5:00pm, food service on site. 972-875-3641. ADDRESS GAP: no street number is published in any reachable source — every directory gives only 'Country Club Rd, Ennis, TX 75119'. Left without a street number rather than guessed. Distinct from Ennis Country Club.

City of Euless muni opened 1997 within the 321-acre Texas Star Sports Centre. Keith Foster design, par 71, 6,936 yds, on-site conference centre. Some directories give a Bedford administrative address (2109 Martin Dr) — the course is at 1400 Texas Star Pkwy in Euless.

PAR-3 COURSE, 9 holes, par 27, 1,365 yds (blue) / 1,171 (white) / 834 (yellow). Holes 128-184 yds, water on six, built around a five-acre lake. Sits within the Westdale Hills apartment complex but is open to the public. HOLE-COUNT CAUTION: GolfPass city directories and GolfLink incorrectly list it as 18 holes; the official site and the GolfPass course page both confirm 9.

Arthur Hills design (2001) inside a gated active-adult community; par 72, ~6,988 yds with notable elevation change. Semi-private but explicitly open to public play with annual passes available; bookable on GolfNow (facility #12113), Chronogolf and Supreme Golf. CITY CORRECTED: frequently mislabeled 'McKinney' in roundups — it is in Fairview.

courses.address: 605 N Interstate 45 Service Rd, Ferris, TX 75125
courses.notes: 18-hole public daily-fee course, par 71, ~6,486 yds, built on the old Ferris Brick Co. site around three former clay quarries — notable elevation changes. Open to the public seven days a week, 364 days a year (closed Christmas). 972-842-8700. NOTE for de-duplication: searches for 'Forney golf course' repeatedly surface this course's '18 holes carved from an old brickyard' description — it is in FERRIS (Ellis County, off I-45), not Forney. 972-842-8700.

courses.address: 4000 W Windsor Dr, Flower Mound, TX 75028
courses.notes: Upscale daily-fee public course, D.A. Weibring design (1997), 7,111 yds, Crenshaw bent greens over 419 bermuda fairways. Green fees roughly $45-$115. Markets itself as 'a private club experience at a daily fee price'.

Public replica course (holes modeled on famous US layouts), David D. Edsall design built 1995, par 72, 7,033 yds, slope 137. Confirmed open and booking tee times via GolfNow. (817) 430-2000. Distinct from and independently operated from the Tour 18 Houston/Humble course.

NAME COLLISION WARNING: distinct from Arlington's 9-hole Meadowbrook Park Golf Course — keep both, they are different facilities in different cities. City of Fort Worth muni in east Fort Worth, par 71, the city's cheapest 18 (~$24-28). Was CLOSED for a multi-year renovation and REOPENED Oct 3, 2025 — many directories still show it closed. Repairs underway on the low-water crossings at holes 7 and 17.

courses.address: 6400 Pecan Valley Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76132
courses.notes: MERGED (duplicate from two sweeps). Second 18 at Pecan Valley; back nine added 1982 by Dave Bennett. More open and hillier than the River Course and ~150 yds shorter (~6,600 yds, par 72). Driving range sits adjacent. Same clubhouse and tee sheet as the River Course.

courses.address: 6400 Pecan Valley Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76132
courses.notes: MERGED (found by fort-worth-city and sw-tarrant sweeps). One of two 18s at the City of Fort Worth's 36-hole Pecan Valley facility in far SW Tarrant County next to Benbrook Lake; the two courses are separated by the Clear Fork of the Trinity. Ralph Plummer design, opened 1963; ~6,100 yds white / ~6,600 blue, bentgrass greens. Widely rated a top Texas muni. As of early 2026 the bridge between #15 and #18 is out of service, temporarily playing #15 as a par 3 and #18 as a par 5. Pro shop (817) 392-6490.

VERIFIED STILL OPERATING (was flagged uncertain). Separate short course / pitch-n-putt along the Trinity River next to Rockwood's 11th fairway and 17th tee; built 2013 by Colligan Golf Design, opened Oct 19 2013. Playable as 6 par-3s or as 2 par-4s + 1 par-3. First Tee - Fort Worth's current participant-perks page still lists free play here for tag holders, confirming active status even though fortworthgolf.org's Rockwood page omits it. Unrated short course.

City of Fort Worth muni. Par 72, up to ~7,053 yds. Historic 1938 course rebuilt in a $5.1M Colligan Golf Design renovation, reopened June 30 2017 (was 27 holes, now 18). Home of First Tee of Fort Worth and the Ben Hogan Learning Center. Pro shop (817) 392-6560.

courses.address: 8940 Creek Run Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76120
courses.notes: 9-hole executive course (eight par 3s + one par 4, par 27-28, ~1,462 yds) with lighted range, across Creek Run Rd from Waterchase. Built 1999; formerly Texas Golf Center / The Jim McLean Golf Center, which closed May 25 2023 and reopened later in 2023 as Texas 9 under new management. Some directories still carry a 'permanently closed' flag under the old name — this course IS open. ~$25 for 9. (817) 303-4370.

courses.facility_name: The Golf Club at Champions Circle
courses.notes: MERGED — the fort-worth-city and denton-nw sweeps recorded this as two records with two addresses (15801 Championship Pkwy vs 3403 Champions Circle Dr) and different designer attributions. It is ONE 18-hole facility. Verified address: 15801 Championship Pkwy, Fort Worth 76177. Greg Norman routing opened 2000, redesigned by Jay Morrish 2002; ~7,147 yds, par 71-72. Adjacent to Texas Motor Speedway; golf property for the DFW Marriott Hotel & Golf Club at Champions Circle. Public daily-fee (also sells memberships), green fees from ~$28; now run by O'Reilly Hospitality. COUNTY UNRESOLVED: TMS is in Denton County and Discover Denton lists it as a Denton-area course, but GolfPass assigns Tarrant — 76177 straddles the line. Recorded as Denton; verify against parcel data. Discover Denton's page incorrectly labels it 'private'; booking sites sell public tee times. Official site returns 403 to automated fetching.

courses.facility_name: The Golf Club at Fossil Creek
courses.notes: Arnold Palmer design opened 1988, north Fort Worth. Par 72. Arcis Golf property; open to the public with tee times on GolfNow/TeeOff/Chronogolf. Functions as daily-fee/semi-private with memberships available. (817) 847-1900. Confirmed open as of late 2025.

courses.facility_name: The Resort Golf Club (The Resort on Eagle Mountain Lake)
courses.address: 5700 The Resort Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76179
courses.notes: Semi-private club on Eagle Mountain Lake, far NW Fort Worth, that sells public tee times (GolfNow, TeeOff, Supreme Golf, own site); GolfPass lists it as Public. Opened 2003, par 72, 6,626 yds. Hours 6:30am-7:00pm. (817) 750-2178. NOT the same as the private Eagle Mountain Country Club at 7200 Golf Club Dr.

courses.address: 8951 Creek Run Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76120
courses.notes: Premium daily-fee public course in east Fort Worth off I-30 near the Arlington line. Par 72, six tee sets, signature cascading waterfall and split fairways. Privately operated (NOT part of the city muni system despite some older articles). (817) 861-4653. Confirmed operating mid-2026.

MERGED — recorded twice (collin-north-dallas at 7170 Anthem Dr, denton-nw at 7401 Frisco Lakes Dr). VERIFIED address: 7170 Anthem Dr, Frisco TX 75036, (972) 292-3089. Public 18 inside the Del Webb Frisco Lakes active-adult community; ~7,099 yds, par 72, Gary Stephenson design — front nine through the community, back nine through open countryside. Sells an all-inclusive round (green fee + lunch + draft beer). In the Denton County portion of Frisco.

courses.facility_name: PGA Frisco / Omni PGA Frisco Resort (Fields Ranch)
courses.notes: MERGED — the collin-north-dallas and denton-nw sweeps each recorded this facility separately with different addresses (3255 PGA Pkwy vs 4341 PGA Pkwy). Verified golf address per PGA of America: Fields Ranch at PGA Frisco, 3725 PGA Parkway, Frisco TX 75033, (469) 888-5855; 4341 PGA Pkwy is the Omni resort hotel. Gil Hanse / Jim Wagner design opened 2023 at the PGA of America headquarters campus; host of the 2027 PGA Championship and the 2025 Women's PGA. Open to public/resort play (walking-only, caddie required); closed Wednesdays for maintenance; public rate observed ~$277. A private club (Club 1916 / fieldsranch.com) also exists on the property but both 18s remain publicly playable. The 660-acre campus is in the Denton County portion of Frisco.

courses.facility_name: PGA Frisco / Omni PGA Frisco Resort (Fields Ranch)
courses.notes: MERGED duplicate from two sweeps. Beau Welling design opened 2023, running along Panther Creek. Open to public/resort play; closed Tuesdays for maintenance; public rate observed ~$222.

courses.facility_name: PGA Frisco / Omni PGA Frisco Resort (Fields Ranch)
courses.notes: MERGED duplicate from two sweeps. Lighted 10-hole par-3 short course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling; holes 45-100 yds with dramatic green complexes. Unrated. Tee times go to Club 1916 members and Omni PGA Frisco guests with confirmed reservations; general public play is walk-up, same day. NOTE: the adjoining 'Dance Floor' putting course was dropped — see dropped_entries.

RENAME: formerly 'Plantation Golf Club' — many older databases still carry that name at this address; same course, renamed, NOT closed. Richard Ellis design (1988), par 72, ~6,375 yds. Operated by Arcis Golf; open to the public with GolfNow tee times (facility #7309). Recently added a Golfzon simulator bay and Harvest Kitchen & Bar.

courses.facility_name: The Trails of Frisco Golf Club
courses.notes: Jeff Brauer design opened 2000/01; rating ~74, slope ~138. Sells public tee times (GolfNow facility #33); GolfPass classifies semi-private. Weekday rates observed ~$59 morning / $49 twilight nine. NOT city-owned despite the Frisco name. Teel Pkwy location is in the Denton County portion of Frisco (some directories say Collin).

courses.facility_name: The Westin Dallas Stonebriar Golf Resort & Spa
courses.notes: BORDERLINE — KEPT under the brief's 'resort courses open to public play' clause, but read the access note before importing. Tom Fazio design, ~7,021 yds. Outside play is limited strictly to guests staying at the Westin Stonebriar resort (seven days a week, tee times up to 30 days out via the resort pro shop); there is NO general daily-fee access, and GolfPass classifies both Stonebriar courses as Private. Anyone can gain access by booking a hotel stay, which is why it is retained rather than dropped. The second Stonebriar course (the Country Club Course) is member-only and IS excluded — see dropped_entries.

Built 1983, Jack Kidwell / Michael Hurdzan design on ~140 acres of a former private arboretum. Confirmed open to the public (Yelp active July 2026, PGA and GolfPass both list it public). Daily-fee play plus annual memberships; some directories tag it semi-private. OWNERSHIP: several sources loosely call it a 'muni' but no City of Garland ownership could be confirmed — it appears privately operated. Website returns 403 to automated fetching.
One of three named nines of the 27-hole Bridges Course. Sometimes spelled 'The Champion' in listings.
One of three named nines making up the 27-hole Bridges Course (opened 2001), played in 18-hole combinations. Bentgrass greens. Facility total across Old + Lakes + Bridges is 63 holes.
One of three named nines of the 27-hole Bridges Course. Sometimes spelled 'The Tradition'. NOT to be confused with The Traditions Course at Watters Creek in Plano.
Second 18 at Firewheel. ~7,134 yds from the tips; water in play on 10 lakes. Sometimes listed as 'Lake Course'.

City of Garland municipal complex totaling 63 holes: Old (18), Lakes (18) and Bridges (27 as three named nines). The Old Course opened 1983, tree-lined with ~65 bunkers. golffirewheel.com returns 403 to automated fetching; data cross-checked via GolfNow/GolfPass/city pages.

36-hole municipal facility ~60 miles SW of the Metroplex — outer edge of the DFW region, include or exclude by radius policy. Apache Links is the original 18, a Jeff Brauer design opened 1992. 4.5 Golf Digest stars; the two courses have been ranked #1 and #4 municipal in Texas by the Dallas Morning News. Fully public. VERIFIED: no name change as of mid-2026 — the facility still operates as Squaw Valley Golf Course with the Apache Links and Comanche Lakes course names. Glen Rose is in Somervell County (not Hood).
Second 18 at Squaw Valley; John Colligan design opened 2001, par 72, ~7,000 yds. Public. Shares clubhouse, pro shop and range with Apache Links.

HOLE COUNT CORRECTED TO 9 (GolfPass and several Weatherford/Granbury guides say 18; it is a 9 played twice). Par 36, 3,054 yds, Leon Howard design opened 1972. Despite the 'country club' name it is open to the public at very low green fees (~$25 for 9 with cart). (817) 573-9912. No official website confirmed.

Richard M. Phelps design opened 2003; par 72, 7,239-7,300 yds along Lake Granbury. Semi-private with an open guest/public play policy; bookable on GolfNow/TeeOff, green fees roughly $40-$90. 10,000 sq ft clubhouse, range, pool. (817) 578-8600.

courses.address: 3502 Country Club Dr, Grand Prairie, TX 75052
courses.notes: RENAME + ACCESS CHANGE: formerly Grand Prairie Country Club; now a semi-private club that sells public tee times through GolfNow/Chronogolf/TeeOff. Older directories still list 'Grand Prairie Country Club - Private', which is out of date. Don January design opened 1972, ~6,360-6,953 yds, par 71-72. 972-264-6161.
Third of three nines at the City of Grand Prairie's 27-hole Prairie Lakes facility.

RENAME: City of Grand Prairie 27-hole facility, formerly 'Grand Prairie Municipal Golf Course'. Three named nines — Red, White, Blue — played in any 18-hole combination (older directories list the combos as Red-White, White-Blue, Blue-Red; modeling as three nines avoids triple-counting). Recently renovated; claims Texas' largest practice area with 8 target greens. 972-237-4156. City page: gptx.org/Parks/Prairie-Lakes-Golf-Course
Second of three nines at the City of Grand Prairie's 27-hole Prairie Lakes facility. Nine names confirmed on the official scorecard page.

Daily-fee course along the Trinity River, Roger Packard design opened 1984; par 72, ~7,000+ yds, rating 72.5 / slope 132. Managed by CourseCo. Sells memberships but books public tee times online. 817-640-7800.

courses.address: 818 Tangle Ridge Dr, Grand Prairie, TX 75052
courses.notes: City of Grand Prairie-owned championship public course near Joe Pool Lake / Cedar Hill. Champion Ultradwarf bermuda greens, significant elevation change. Frequently listed among the best municipal courses in Texas. 972-299-6837. City page: gptx.org/Parks/Tangle-Ridge-Golf-Club

Dallas Cowboys-themed daily-fee club founded by Jerry Jones, operated by Arcis Golf. Fully open to the public on an all-inclusive green fee. All 18 greens renovated by Beau Welling; ranked #15 public course in Texas by Golfweek. Directly adjacent to the Grapevine muni on the same Fairway Dr — two separate facilities, do not merge.

City of Grapevine 27-hole muni with three named nines (Bluebonnet, Mockingbird, Pecan) played in rotating 18-hole combinations; the pro shop assigns which two nines you play on weekends. Bluebonnet is the D.A. Weibring addition that opened fall 1999. MODELING NOTE: GolfPass/Golf Digest list this facility as three 18-hole combos (Mockingbird/Pecan, Pecan/Bluebonnet, Mockingbird/Bluebonnet) — modeling as three nines avoids triple-counting.
One of three nines at the City of Grapevine's 27-hole muni. Part of the original Byron Nelson / Joe Finger 18 (1979); renovated and reopened spring 2002. Generally the flattest of the three nines.

One of three nines at the City of Grapevine's 27-hole muni. Part of the original Byron Nelson / Joe Finger 18 (1979); D.A. Weibring renovation reopened June 2003. Considered the hardest of the three nines.

City of Greenville Parks & Recreation muni. 9 holes on a 39-acre site; par listed as 36-37 depending on source (GolfPass shows par 37). Also appears in directories as 'Wright Park Municipal Golf Course'. (903) 457-2996.

GEOGRAPHY FLAG — Grayson County is NOT in the DFW MSA (it is the Sherman-Denison MSA) but IS in the DFW-Sherman-Denison CSA; Gunter sits immediately north of the Collin County line, roughly 50 minutes from north Dallas, i.e. closer in than Mabank/Henderson County which the master list already includes. Drop if OpenTee uses a strict MSA boundary. Semi-private club that explicitly welcomes daily-fee players: the club's own site has a dedicated /public-tee-times/ page routing to GolfNow, and TeeOff, GolfLink, Supreme Golf and Golf Book all carry live tee sheets. Jeffrey Brauer design with Fred Couples, opened 2008. Par 72, 7,601 yds from the tips — one of the longest courses in North Texas — with five tee sets starting at 5,193 yds. Contact (903) 696-0022; club email routes to Centurion American (the developer). NOT to be confused with Firewheel's 'The Bridges' 27-hole course in Garland, which is already in the master list.

FLAGGED FOR RESOLUTION — DO NOT PUBLISH AS PUBLIC WITHOUT A PHONE CALL. Reported because it is a real, modern 18 in a Rockwall County city with no master-list entry, and sources directly contradict each other on access. FOR PUBLIC: GolfLink states plainly 'Heath Golf & Yacht Club is open to the public'; GolfNow carries facility 18228 and TeeOff carries facility -6714 with tee-time search pages; grassy.golf advertises bookable tee times. AGAINST PUBLIC: GolfPass classifies it 'Resort/Private' in both the Heath and Rockwall city directories, and the master-planned-community marketing (Beazer, CastleRock, heathgolfandyachtclub.com) describes 'a private golf course' as a resident amenity. The club's own heath-countryclub.com site publishes no green fees or guest policy. Course facts: 18 holes, par 72, 7,068 yds from the tips, Roy Bechtol design, built 2019, ~20 miles east of downtown Dallas. (972) 552-6079. MODELING NOTE: GolfPass splits it into two records, 'Heath Golf & Yacht Club - 1st Nine' and '- 2nd Nine'; it is one 18-hole routing — do not import as two courses. Also do not confuse with Buffalo Creek Golf Club, which is already in the master list and which several booking sites give a Heath, TX city even though its mailing address is Rockwall.

courses.address: 2000 E Shady Grove Rd, Irving, TX 75060
courses.notes: RENAME/REBUILD: this is the former Twin Wells Golf Course (Twin Wells Municipal). The City of Irving closed it, had it redesigned by Ault, Clark & Associates, and reopened it in 2019 as Irving Golf Club. GolfLink, Tripadvisor and Chronogolf still carry a separate 'Twin Wells Golf Course' record — it is the same facility, not a second course. Sits in Twin Wells Park along the Trinity River. (972) 457-0772.

courses.facility_name: The Nelson Golf & Sports Club (formerly TPC Four Seasons Las Colinas)
courses.notes: Second 18 of the same 36-hole Las Colinas resort facility. Robert Trent Jones Jr. design (1982), par 71, ~7,120 yds. Same access rules as TPC Las Colinas: members and Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas hotel guests only. Has a legacy site at cottonwoodvalley.com.

courses.facility_name: The Nelson Golf & Sports Club (formerly TPC Four Seasons Las Colinas)
courses.notes: BORDERLINE — KEPT under the 'resort courses open to public play' clause; read the access note. 36-hole facility attached to The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas (rebranded from Four Seasons in Jan 2024 after a $55M renovation; golf operated as 'The Nelson Golf & Sports Club' by Century Golf Partners). Former host of the AT&T Byron Nelson. NOT daily-fee: play is limited to club members and to guests with a confirmed Ritz-Carlton reservation, and the Irving CVB labels it 'Private'. Jay Morrish design with Byron Nelson and Ben Crenshaw. Drop both Nelson rows if OpenTee's definition of public excludes hotel-guest-only access.

Founded 1964/65. Despite the 'country club' name it sells public tee times (GolfNow/Chronogolf, ~$45 for 18). Par 71, 6,542 yds; pool and tennis on site. (817) 295-7126. Some aggregators list ZIP 76028 (Burleson) — the course is in Joshua.

Robert Trent Jones Jr. design, built 1999. Par 72, 6,953 yds. Privately owned but fully open to the public with tee times on GolfNow/Chronogolf; also sells memberships, so some directories tag it semi-private. The only golf course inside Keller city limits.

27-hole public facility with three nines (Blue / White / Red), Ken Andrews design opened c.1990-91, Cedar Creek Lake area in southern Kaufman County. Blue+White is commonly played as the main 18. DATA CAVEAT: sources disagree on totals (one lists 27 holes at 5,208 yds par 71 for the played 18; another describes an 18 plus a separate 9) — per-nine par and yardage need on-site confirmation. (903) 498-3564. About 50-60 min from downtown Dallas, at the outer edge of the Metroplex.
Third of three nines at the 27-hole Indian Oaks public facility. Some directories describe this nine as a shorter/executive-length loop — yardages should be verified on site.
Second of three nines at the 27-hole Indian Oaks public facility. See the Blue Nine record for facility-level detail and data caveats.

Single 18 opened 1980, par 71, 6,507 yds, slope 124, driving range. Semi-private on Cedar Creek Lake; TexasGolf.com and GolfLink list it public/semi-private and it takes outside tee times by phone at (903) 498-8888. Roughly 50 minutes from downtown Dallas, at the outer edge of the DFW radius.

Owned by the City of Lancaster, managed by KemperSports. Ron Garl design built 1989; par 70, ~6,461 yds. Open daily 6:30am-7pm. 972-227-0995. Also listed as 'Country View Golf Club'. Management page: kempersports.com/properties/country-view-golf-course/

City of Lewisville-owned, operated by Arcis Golf. 18 holes, 6,135 yds, par 70; built 1996, Jeff Brauer / Lanny Wadkins design. Named a Golf Digest 'Best Places You Can Play'. Pro shop (972) 219-5661. Facility also has a 20-acre lighted practice area and FootGolf.

Separate lighted 9-hole executive course (par 29, ~1,724 yds, Dick Watson, 1994) at the same city-owned Lake Park complex on Lewisville Lake, with its own address and pro shop phone (972) 436-3113. Listed as a distinct course by GolfPass and by the city.

Phil Lumsden design opened 1988/89; par 72, 5,305-6,810 yds over four tee sets, tree-lined along the Brazos. Sells public tee times online plus memberships. Postal city Lipan; the property sits on the Hood/Parker line and is listed under either county. Older listings mention an additional short/par-3 course here that could NOT be confirmed as still in play — not recorded. (817) 341-1111.

courses.facility_name: The Pinnacle Golf Club at Cedar Creek Lake
courses.notes: Single 18, Don January design (1988), par 72, ~6,349-6,600 yds, ten water holes along Cedar Creek Lake. Historically also known as Pinnacle Golf & Boat Club. Semi-private but explicitly open to public play; restaurant, driving range, pool, tennis. GEOGRAPHY FLAG: Henderson County (Mabank / Gun Barrel City), about 60 minutes from downtown Dallas — outside the DFW MSA proper, included as the Cedar Creek Lake anchor course. Drop if the database uses a strict MSA boundary.

Owned by the City of Mansfield, operated under contract by Arcis Golf. Par 72, 6,850 yds back / 5,263 forward. The only public course inside Mansfield city limits (Walnut Creek CC's Oak and Pecan 18s are strictly private). City page: mansfieldtexas.gov/1078/Mansfield-National-Golf-Club. (817) 477-3366.

RENAME: City of McKinney muni, formerly McKinney Municipal Golf Course — stale directories carry both names for the same property. Walkable layout with driving range and short-game area. Listed in the City of McKinney parks directory.

courses.address: 9055 N Cotton Ridge Rd, McKinney, TX 75072
courses.notes: Public 18-hole championship course marketed as the only 6-6-6 layout in Texas (six par 3s, six par 4s, six par 5s). Online tee-time booking, driving range and short-game practice areas.

Owned and operated by the City of Mesquite. Appears in directories as 'Mesquite Municipal Golf Course' and at '825 N Hwy 67' (same property, I-30/US-67 frontage) — ONE facility, not two. Originally 9 holes (Leon Howard, 1965), expanded to 18; major renovation completed 2013 and reopened 2014 (Texas Turfgrass Association Course of the Year), further work by Jeff Brauer c.2020. ~6,885 yds, par 71. 972-270-7457.

GEOGRAPHY FLAG — Cooke County (Gainesville micropolitan area), roughly 80 miles north of Dallas and 70 north of Fort Worth; outside the DFW MSA though inside the broader North Texas region and carried in the Texas Golf Insider DFW directory. Drop if OpenTee uses a strict MSA boundary. Fully public daily-fee. 18 holes, par 72, ~6,510 yds; Dick Murphy design built 1993. Bentgrass greens, rolling wooded terrain. Turtle Hill Lodge & Conference Center sits across the road for stay-and-play. CONFIRMED CURRENT: Yelp listing updated June 2026, Tripadvisor 2026 reviews, active Facebook page (@PlaytheTurtle). (940) 759-4896.

courses.address: 6200 Skylark Cir, North Richland Hills, TX 76180
courses.notes: Owned by the City of North Richland Hills, run as a self-supporting enterprise fund. Railroad-themed layout; major renovation completed September 2020; 50,000+ rounds a year. City facility page: https://www.nrhtx.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/42

9-hole par-3 course plus a 55-station full-service driving range on 15 acres; opened by Jeff Christie (land purchased 2008). Pro shop, instruction, junior camps, memberships, weekly men's group. Open 9:00am-7:30pm daily. (214) 317-1488. The only golf course in Pilot Point and in far-northern Denton County.

City of Plano Parks & Recreation muni. Don January design (1973), fully rebuilt and reopened in the early 2020s; ~7,026 yds, MiniVerde greens, five tee sets. Lighted driving range, 14,000 sq ft putting green, chipping green with three practice bunkers. Typically closed Mondays.

Unnamed 5-hole short course on the same City of Plano property as the main 18. Unrated. Recorded separately because it is a playable short course rather than a practice area; a consumer of this data may prefer to fold it into the parent facility record.
Opened 1996; ~7,025 yds, par 72, 78 bunkers, four tee sets. Fully public daily-fee, bookable on GolfNow/Chronogolf. Confirmed taking 2026 tee times.
6-hole par-3 course, all holes 40-120 yds, part of the practice center. Unrated, beginner/junior oriented.
9 holes, par 30 (six par 3s, three par 4s). Executive nine at the same facility as Traditions. Descendant of the old Chase Oaks 'Blackjack' nine.

RENAME: formerly Chase Oaks Golf Club — many databases still carry 'Chase Oaks' at this address; same property, not closed. Multi-course facility: Traditions (18 regulation) + The Players Course (9 executive) + The Futures Course (6-hole par 3). Despite the 'Watters Creek' (Allen) branding the property address is in Plano near the Allen line.

courses.facility_name: Tanglewood Resort Hotel and Conference Center
courses.notes: GEOGRAPHY FLAG — Grayson County, on Lake Texoma, about one hour north of the Metroplex; outside the DFW MSA. Drop if OpenTee uses a strict MSA boundary. Genuinely public: the resort's own golf page states the course is open to the public with daily tee times, and GolfPass lists the facility as open to the public. 18 holes, par 72, ~6,993-7,000 yds. Ralph Plummer original with Arnold Palmer involvement; sources disagree on the opening year (resort site says 1973, GolfPass says 1964). Diamond Zoysia greens for year-round playability, water on seven holes, lakeside routing. All-inclusive 18-hole green fee bundles shared cart, unlimited range balls and putting green access. Hours 7:00am-7:00pm daily. (903) 786-4638. ADDRESS CAUTION: GolfPass lists 290 Tanglewood Circle (the hotel) while the golf shop address is 586 Country Club Dr — one facility.

Public 9-hole par-3 / pitch-and-putt (~706 yds, par 27) attached to a driving range with covered hitting bays and putting/chipping greens. Walking allowed, rental clubs available. INCLUDED (not dropped as a range) because it has a real playable 9-hole course. Unrated. Part of the multi-location Golf Ranch chain. This address is in the Dallas County portion of Richardson.

City of Richardson 36-hole muni. Course One is par 72, Leon Howard design (1971), redesigned by D.A. Weibring / Design Resource in 1997. Consistently ranked among the top 10 municipal courses in Texas. The Sherrill Park property is in the Collin County portion of Richardson, north of PGBT.
Second 18 at the City of Richardson muni. Par 70, shorter and more technical than Course One; D.A. Weibring redesign completed 2001.

Single 18. Jay Morrish / Tom Weiskopf design opened 1992, par 71. Sits on the Rockwall/Heath line — GolfNow, TeeOff and the club's Facebook give the city as Heath, TX while the mailing address is Rockwall 75032. Fully open to public tee times on GolfNow/TeeOff/Chronogolf. (972) 771-4003.

ADDRESS RESOLVED (the sweep left it blank): 2600 Champions Dr, Rockwall, TX 75087, confirmed via PGA of America and Yelp. Single 18, 7,281 yds, par 72, built 1979, bermuda greens and fairways. Member club that also sells public tee times — the club's golf page says public access is offered 'at the discretion of our golf shop', and PGA/Texas Outside list it as open to the public. Listed on GolfNow. (972) 771-0301.

ACCESS/OWNERSHIP RESOLVED: verified city-owned — the City of Rowlett owns the course and contracts management to American Golf; the city maintains a Golf Advisory Board and lists it in its facilities directory. Reclassified from daily_fee to municipal. Gary Panks design opened 1999/2000; ~7,191 yds, par 72, five tee sets, 15+ acres of lakes. Resident rates offered. Practice facility includes a 3-hole practice course and 45-stall range.

courses.address: 2001 Stone River Blvd, Royse City, TX 75189
courses.notes: Single 18, par 71, ~6,400-6,524 yds, five tee sets. Fully public, bookable on GolfNow/TeeOff. (972) 636-2254. ADDRESS CONFLICT: Yelp lists 846 FM 2453, Royse City — that is likely the highway-frontage entrance; 2001 Stone River Blvd is the clubhouse. A stonerivergolf.com domain is also used for tee times.

courses.address: 400 Half Moon Way, Runaway Bay, TX 76426
courses.notes: ADDED BY CONSOLIDATION — Wise County (a DFW MSA county) was not covered by any of the eight sweeps. The only 18-hole course in Wise County. Par 72, 7,032 yds, Leon Howard design, built 1969, near Lake Bridgeport; bentgrass greens, four tee sets. Open to the public with full resort/event facilities and the Lakeview Tavern & Grill. (940) 575-2225. STATUS FLAG: the Yelp listing carries a CLOSED banner updated March 2026, while GolfNow and TeeOff carry live tee sheets, the City of Runaway Bay's own visitor golf page lists it as operating, and the Facebook page is active. Recorded as open; worth a phone confirmation before publishing.

9 holes, par 36 per GolfPass. HOLE-COUNT CAUTION: several directories erroneously show 18 holes / par 72 by doubling the nine, and PGA.com still uses the older name 'Oak Grove Country Club'. Original course dates to the 1920s; Ralph Plummer work c.1979. Pro shop, driving range, putting green. Open to the public. (972) 563-8553. No standalone website found.

Second 18 of the Tribute complex; Tripp Davis + Justin Leonard design opened 2010 (originally 'The New Course'). Semi-private but sells public tee times; ranked Golf Magazine's #5 Best Public Course in Texas. Former host of LPGA/Web.com-era events at The Colony.

Scottish-links replica course on Lewisville Lake, Tripp Davis design opened 2000. One of two 18s in the 36-hole 'Golf Clubs at The Tribute' complex, marketed together with Old American. Sometimes branded 'The Tribute Golf Club - Old Course'. Clubhouse has guest suites / stay-and-play.

courses.address: 100 Cottonwood Springs Cir, The Colony, TX 75056
courses.notes: 9-hole public course on a peninsula in Lewisville Lake (65+ acres) with double greens and six tee boxes per hole, so it plays as a varied 18 over two loops; lighthouse-style clubhouse. On City of The Colony parkland (Wynnewood Peninsula) and promoted on the city's golf page. Pro shop 972-625-8700, tournaments 972-625-1106.

RENAME: formerly (and still listed in many directories as) Waxahachie Country Club — now rebranded Waxahachie Golf Club and open for public tee times booked up to 14 days out while still selling memberships. Open daily 7:00am-7:00pm. 972-937-3521. The only golf course in the city of Waxahachie.

Owned by Weatherford College (a public community college) and run as a public daily-fee course; GolfPass lists it Public, some directories say semi-private. Wes Mickle design opened 1997. Par 72, 6,653 yds. Alternate address seen in listings: 200 Canyon West Dr. Highest-rated Weatherford course on GolfPass (4.28 from 882 reviews).

HOLE COUNT CORRECTED TO 9 (many directories including GolfPass say 18). 9 holes, par 36, 3,219 yds, built 1975; a second set of tees allows an 18-hole double loop, which is the source of the 18-hole error. Open to public play. Narrow pecan-lined fairways in the Horseshoe Bend community on the Brazos. (817) 594-6454. No official website confirmed.

Steve Mrak design, ~7,242 yds. Opened 2002 as the private Golf Club at Crown Valley; went bankrupt and closed 2011, reopened 2013 as Oeste Ranch — stale 'Crown Valley' records are the same property. Open for public play Tuesday-Sunday; restaurant open to the public with no tee time required. Off Mikus Rd north of I-20 near Lake Weatherford.

courses.address: 2104 E State Highway 276, West Tawakoni, TX 75474
courses.notes: RENAME: this is the renamed Tawakoni Golf Club — same phone (903) 447-2981, same site. Many directories still carry a separate 'Tawakoni Golf Club, Quinlan, TX 75474' record (Quinlan is the mailing identity for the area); it is ONE facility, not two. 18 holes, par 72, 6,727 yds, John/Bill Lively design opened 1971, on a 200-acre peninsula on Lake Tawakoni. Open to the public, driving range and putting green.

courses.address: 6520 White Settlement Rd, Westworth Village, TX 76114
courses.notes: CITY CORRECTED: owned by the City of Westworth Village, an incorporated enclave adjacent to Fort Worth — NOT inside Fort Worth city limits, despite a Fort Worth 76114 mailing address that causes GolfPass and others to file it under Fort Worth. Par 72, 6,898 yds, ~4 miles from downtown FW off Hwy 183. Built on former Carswell AFB / NAS Fort Worth JRB course land; reopened as a public club in 2002. Open daily 7am-7pm, (817) 738-8402.

courses.address: 1605 Ranch House Rd, Willow Park, TX 76087
courses.notes: Built by Ralph Plummer in the early 1970s as a recreation course for Convair/Lockheed employees; owned by CERA (cera-fw.org) and now fully open to the public. Par 71, 6,749 yds; GolfPass lists semi-private. A First Tee - Fort Worth program site. The pro shop building closed in early 2026 for water damage with check-in moved to the Outpost room, but the course stayed open. (817) 441-8185.

MSA GAP — second missing Hunt County course. Despite the 'country club' name it is open to the public: GolfDigest labels the facility 'Public', GolfPass/GolfLink call it semi-private open to public play, and the club's own site runs a 'Book Tee Times' online inventory; a GolfNow facility page (10675) exists. 18 holes, par 72, 6,787 yds from the tips, rating 72.9 / slope 127, bermuda. Developed 1969 under Bobby Owens; Leon Howard design. Heavily wooded with narrow undulating fairways, some blind and elevated tee shots, water on about half the holes. CONFIRMED CURRENT: public 18-hole rates observed around $42-43 as of July 2026; Yelp listing updated June 2026 with no closed banner. Pro shop (903) 496-2221; ask for Scott at (903) 496-7500. Wolfe City is in northern Hunt County, ~15 miles north of Greenville.

Public 18 opened 1999, Singletary Golf Services design; ~7,016 yds, par 72, wetlands/woodlands style with water on nearly every hole. Golf Digest 4 stars. COUNTY CAVEAT: the mailing address is Wylie 75098 (Collin County city) but the property is understood to sit in the Dallas County portion adjacent to Sachse — some directories list it under Sachse, TX.
